description: This file defines API utility functions for the WebFrontend project, enabling HTTP requests such as GET, POST, DELETE, and PATCH to communicate with the backend. It includes internal logic for handling authorization headers, error handling (including automatic logout on 401 responses), and specific methods for work item comments and status updates. It exports multiple functions for frontend use concerning work items and comments.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a given API path is public (no authorization required), such as login/signup endpoints.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds the request headers, adding Authorization when the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles non-OK responses, throwing errors, and managing auto-logout on 401 responses.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns the parsed response or throws an error on failure.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body, returns parsed response or throws an error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, returning the parsed response.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body, returns parsed response or throws an error.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item, given project ID and item ID.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from localStorage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with provided details, including creator info from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for a given API path based on current base URL.
